## Cargoship configuration file

holds the values for the `.`, or root, section of the config file

Rendered from `schema/zarf-config-distro-schema.json`.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property       | Type                            | Required | Default   | Description                                                                                                                      |
| -------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `age`          | [AgeOptions](#ageoptions)       | no       |           | are the age keys used to encrypt and decrypt registry credentials                                                                |
| `architecture` | `string`                        | no       |           | the CPU architecture to use for OCI operations                                                                                   |
| `distro`       | [DistroOptions](#distrooptions) | no       |           | are various options used by the command                                                                                          |
| `log_file`     | `boolean`                       | no       |           | enables always writing a full-verbosity debug log to a file, regardless of LogLevel                                              |
| `log_format`   | `string`                        | no       | `console` | how the logs are displayed well running One of `console`, `json`, `dev`.                                                         |
| `log_level`    | `string`                        | no       | `info`    | the level of logs that will be displayed One of `warn`, `info`, `debug`, `trace`.                                                |
| `no_color`     | `boolean`                       | no       |           | whether to disable terminal color codes in logging and stdout prints                                                             |
| `timeout`      | `string`                        | no       | `20m`     | the longest we will run long ran tasks before failing                                                                            |
| `tmp_dir`      | `string`                        | no       | `/tmp`    | the directory where we store stuff before deleting them                                                                          |
| `zarf_cache`   | `string`                        | no       |           | is the folder where cargoship caches what it fetches: oras artifacts, and the release assets the example generation targets read |

</div>

### AgeOptions

holds the values for the `.age` section of the config file, the age alternative to the Ansible Vault password given by --vault-password-file.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property           | Type              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `identity_files`   | array of `string` | no       |         | are paths to identity files, each holding either the age private keys that<br>decrypt registry credentials or an SSH private key. A leading ~ is expanded to the home<br>directory of the user running cargoship. Equivalent to repeating --age-identity-file.                                                |
| `recipients`       | array of `string` | no       |         | are the public keys registry credentials are encrypted to, each either an age<br>recipient or an SSH public key. Equivalent to repeating --age-recipient.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `recipients_files` | array of `string` | no       |         | are paths to files holding public keys, one per line, with # comments<br>allowed, mixing age recipients and SSH public keys freely. An authorized_keys file works as<br>it is. A leading ~ is expanded to the home directory of the user running cargoship.<br>Equivalent to repeating --age-recipients-file. |

</div>

### DistroCreateOptions

holds the values for the `.distro.create` section of the config file

<div class="schema-table">

| Property            | Type                                        | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file_override`     | [FileOverrideMap](#fileoverridemap)         | no       |         | maps a source URL prefix to the location cargoship downloads from<br>instead, for example {"https://rpm.rancher.io": "https://mirror.example.com/rpm-rancher"}.<br>The value may also be a local directory, for builds from pre-staged assets. |
| `registry_override` | [RegistryOverrideMap](#registryoverridemap) | no       |         | maps a source registry to the registry cargoship uses instead<br>when pulling images, for example {"docker.io": "mirror.example.com"}                                                                                                          |

</div>
